title: The Salt Ledger
setting_summary: In the walled harbor city of Vaernholm, a quarantine authority called the Salt Ledger controls every entry, exit, and ration during a decade-long plague season. Its clerks record citizens' words as taxable property, and a single disputed entry can condemn a family to the outer wharves. As the Ledger's aging directorate fractures, five keepers of the record must decide whether ledgers can ever be rewritten.
